# Environment variables

> Generated by `tools/gen_environment_registry.py` from `src/molt/environment_registry.toml`; do not edit.

Every `MOLT_*` name Molt reads is registered here: 793 fixed variables, 11 families over 59 guard scopes, 1 open prefix families, and 39 retired names.

The `molt` CLI and the developer `RunContext` inspect the process environment on start. An unknown `MOLT_*` name prints a warning on stderr with close matches. A retired name is an error that names the replacement: Molt keeps no aliases.

Value kinds: `bool` accepts `1`/`true`/`yes`/`on` and `0`/`false`/`no`/`off`; `path-list` and `list` use the platform path separator or commas as the reader documents; `enum` lists its values.

| `MOLT_TRUSTED_SIGNERS` | path | unset | `src/molt/cli/entrypoint_dispatch.py` | Path to the trust-policy file (JSON or TOML) of trusted signers for molt publish; --trusted-signers and the publish config take precedence; a remote-registry publish that requires or verifies signatures fails when neither is set. |
| `MOLT_TV_DIR` | path | unset | `src/molt/frontend/tv_hooks.py` | Directory where the translation-validation hooks write per-pass before/after IR snapshots when MOLT_TV_EMIT=1; it is created if missing; unset means a fresh molt_tv_ directory under MOLT_DIFF_TMPDIR, TMPDIR, MOLT_EXT_ROOT/tmp or the repo-local tmp directory, printed to stderr on first use. |
| `MOLT_TV_EMIT` | bool | `0` | `src/molt/frontend/tv_hooks.py` | Set to exactly 1 to make the mid-end write before/after IR snapshots for every pass into the MOLT_TV_DIR dump directory; the value is read once per process; any other value or unset disables emission. |
| `MOLT_TY_TIMEOUT` | float | `30` | `src/molt/cli/typecheck.py` | Timeout in seconds for the ty check subprocess that src/molt/cli/typecheck.py runs; non-numeric or non-positive values fall back to 30. |
| `MOLT_USE_SCCACHE` | enum: `auto`, `0`, `1`, `false`, `true`, `no`, `yes`, `off`, `on` | `auto` | `src/molt/cli/cargo_execution.py` | Controls whether Molt Cargo builds wire sccache as RUSTC_WRAPPER: 0, false, no or off disables it, 1, true, yes or on forces the pinned sccache, and auto (the default when unset) uses it when provisioned except on Windows where auto means off; DX shells from molt.dx preset 1 (0 on Windows). |
| `MOLT_VERIFY_ANALYSIS` | bool | `0` | `runtime/molt-passes/src/tir/pass_manager.rs` | Set to exactly 1 to run the per-pass analysis self-check after every TIR pass in the pass manager; unset or any other value skips the check. |
| `MOLT_VERIFY_SIGNATURE` | bool | `0` | `src/molt/cli/entrypoint_dispatch.py` | Enables signature verification for molt publish when --verify-signature and the publish config leave it unset; 1, true, yes or on (case-insensitive) enable it; any other value or unset means off, except that a remote-registry publish which requires signatures turns it on. |
| `MOLT_VFS_BUNDLE` | path | unset | `runtime/molt-runtime-vfs/src/load.rs` | Path to a directory or .tar file that the runtime mounts at /bundle in its virtual filesystem on first VFS access, together with /tmp and /dev mounts; molt-wasm-host --bundle and wasm/run_wasm.js set it for the WASM guest; unset means no virtual filesystem. |
| `MOLT_VFS_BUNDLE_MAX_BYTES` | int | `268435456` | `runtime/molt-runtime-vfs/src/load.rs` | Maximum total bytes the VFS bundle loader accepts across all bundle entries; non-numeric or zero values fall back to 268435456 (256 MiB). |
| `MOLT_VFS_BUNDLE_MAX_ENTRIES` | int | `100000` | `runtime/molt-runtime-vfs/src/load.rs` | Maximum number of entries the VFS bundle loader accepts; non-numeric or zero values fall back to 100000. |
| `MOLT_VFS_BUNDLE_MAX_ENTRY_BYTES` | int | `67108864` | `runtime/molt-runtime-vfs/src/load.rs` | Maximum bytes of one bundle entry the VFS bundle loader accepts; non-numeric or zero values fall back to 67108864 (64 MiB). |
| `MOLT_VFS_BUNDLE_MAX_PATH_BYTES` | int | `16777216` | `runtime/molt-runtime-vfs/src/load.rs` | Maximum total bytes of entry paths the VFS bundle loader accepts across the bundle; non-numeric or zero values fall back to 16777216 (16 MiB). |
| `MOLT_VFS_BUNDLE_UNSAFE_FOLLOW_HOST_LINKS` | bool | `0` | `runtime/molt-runtime-vfs/src/load.rs` | Set to exactly 1 to let a directory bundle follow host symlinks, junctions and other reparse points into /bundle for native development; unset, empty or 0 rejects any host link, and any other value fails the bundle load. |
| `MOLT_VFS_TMP_QUOTA_MB` | int | `64` | `runtime/molt-runtime-vfs/src/load.rs` | Quota in MiB for the in-memory /tmp mount of the runtime virtual filesystem; molt-wasm-host sets it for the guest from --vfs-tmp-quota; non-numeric values or unset mean 64. |
| `MOLT_VRANGE_REPORT` | bool | `0` | `runtime/molt-passes/src/tir/passes/value_range/mod.rs` | Set to exactly 1 to emit a per-function value-range report (loop-header induction-variable recurrences and every proven global integer range) to the debug-artifact channel after the value-range pass; unset or any other value emits nothing. |
| `MOLT_WASI_SYSROOT` | path | unset | `src/molt/cli/runtime_wasm_build_support.py` | Path to the WASI sysroot used for wasm32 runtime builds, source-extension compiles and wasi-libc archive lookup; WASI_SYSROOT names the same fact; unset means the sysroot resolves from WASI_SDK_PATH, WASI_SDK_PREFIX, MOLT_TARGET_ROOT, the provisioned WASI SDK or known system locations, and Molt exports the resolved path to its build children. |
| `MOLT_WASM_CACHE` | bool | unset | `runtime/molt-wasm-host/src/engine.rs` | Controls the Wasmtime compilation cache in molt-wasm-host: 1 enables the default cache, 0 disables caching even when MOLT_WASM_CACHE_CONFIG is set, and any other value is an error; unset means disabled unless MOLT_WASM_CACHE_CONFIG names a config file. |
| `MOLT_WASM_CACHE_CONFIG` | path | unset | `runtime/molt-wasm-host/src/engine.rs` | Path to a Wasmtime cache configuration file that molt-wasm-host loads for its compilation cache; an empty value is an error and MOLT_WASM_CACHE=0 overrides it; unset means no config file. |
| `MOLT_WASM_CALL_INDIRECT_DEBUG` | bool | `0` | `wasm/loader_bridge.js` | Set to exactly 1 to make the WASM host scripts (run_wasm.js, loader_bridge.js and browser_host.js when run under Node) print each molt_call_indirect dispatch with its table index and call arguments to stderr; any other value or unset stays silent. |
| `MOLT_WASM_CALL_INDIRECT_SMOKE` | bool | `0` | `wasm/run_wasm.js` | Set to exactly 1 to make wasm/run_wasm.js call the output module's molt_call_indirect2 export once before normal startup and print the result to stderr; it throws when the export is missing; any other value or unset skips the smoke call. |
| `MOLT_WASM_CARGO_PROFILE` | string | unset | `src/molt/cli/runtime_wasm_build_policy.py` | Cargo profile for the wasm32 runtime build; it wins over MOLT_RUNTIME_BUILD_PROFILE; unset or blank means MOLT_RUNTIME_BUILD_PROFILE when set, else wasm-release for the release profile, else the selected Cargo profile; tools/verified_subset.py strips it from the build environment. |
| `MOLT_WASM_CC` | string | unset | `src/molt/cli/source_extension_toolchain.py` | WASM C compiler for source-plan extension builds, as an executable path or a command line; it is preferred over MOLT_CROSS_CC and must compile a WASI probe before upstream packages compile; the name matches case-insensitively on Windows; unset falls back to MOLT_CROSS_CC, zig, or clang with a WASI sysroot. |
| `MOLT_WASM_COMPILE_FAST` | bool | `0` | `runtime/molt-wasm-host/src/engine.rs` | Set to 1 to make molt-wasm-host compile WASM with optimization level none for faster loading at lower run speed; 0 or unset keeps full optimization; any other value is an error. |
| `MOLT_WASM_COMPILE_SERIAL` | bool | `0` | `runtime/molt-wasm-host/src/engine.rs` | Set to 1 to make molt-wasm-host compile WASM modules serially instead of in parallel; 0 or unset keeps parallel compilation; any other value is an error. |
| `MOLT_WASM_DB_COMPILED_EXPORTS` | path | unset | `runtime/molt-wasm-host/src/path_resolver.rs` | Path to a compiled-exports manifest that molt-wasm-host and wasm/run_wasm.js pass to molt-worker as --compiled-exports when they spawn the database worker; unset passes no compiled exports. |
| `MOLT_WASM_DB_TIMEOUT_MS` | int | `250` | `runtime/molt-wasm-host/src/path_resolver.rs` | Timeout in milliseconds for database worker queries issued by molt-wasm-host and wasm/run_wasm.js; the retired MOLT_DB_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS is read as a fallback; non-numeric values or unset mean 250. |
| `MOLT_WASM_DICT_METHOD_DEBUG` | bool | `0` | `runtime/molt-runtime/src/builtins/containers.rs` | Set to exactly 1 on wasm32 builds to print the function address of the dict get, setdefault and fromkeys method descriptors to stderr when they are built; any other value, unset or a non-wasm32 build stays silent. |
| `MOLT_WASM_HOST_BIN` | path | unset | `src/molt/cli/wasm_host.py` | Explicit path of the prebuilt molt-wasm-host executable for compiler, benchmark and validation consumers; a value that is not a regular file resolves to no host. When unset, select the caller's target directory, else the project's Cargo target from molt.dx.project_cargo_target_dir (CARGO_TARGET_DIR, the development artifact root, or <root>/target), using only the requested Cargo profile and native executable suffix; a missing selected binary never falls through to another build. |
| `MOLT_WASM_HOST_DEBUG` | bool | `0` | `runtime/molt-wasm-host/src/main.rs` | Presence of the variable with any value switches the molt-wasm-host default log filter from off to off,molt_wasm_host=debug so host stage diagnostics reach stderr; a MOLT_WASM_HOST_LOG value replaces that filter. |
| `MOLT_WASM_HOST_LOG` | string | unset | `runtime/molt-wasm-host/src/main.rs` | env_logger filter directive for molt-wasm-host stderr diagnostics, for example off,molt_wasm_host::precompiled=debug; when unset the filter is off, or off,molt_wasm_host=debug when MOLT_WASM_HOST_DEBUG is set. |
| `MOLT_WASM_IMPORT_AUDIT` | bool | `0` | `runtime/molt-backend-wasm/src/wasm/module_abi/finalize.rs` | Set to 1 to print wasm backend import-usage diagnostics to stderr: the used and unused import counts at module finalization, the imports removed by import stripping with the byte savings, and the generic-lowering reason for each function the fast lowering rejects; any other value is off. |
| `MOLT_WASM_LD` | path | unset | `src/molt/llvm_toolchain.py` | Path of the wasm-ld executable for wasm links; it must name one executable without arguments and be the wasm-ld entrypoint. When unset, wasm-ld comes only from the manifest-owned WASI SDK (WASI_SDK_PATH or the provisioned SDK), never from PATH; SDK provisioning, the proof queue and the release workflow set it to the provisioned SDK's wasm-ld for child builds. |
| `MOLT_WASM_LINKED` | bool | `1` | `src/molt/cli/build_output_layout.py` | Controls whether a wasm build produces linked output by default; unset or any value other than 0, false, no, or off (case-insensitive) selects linked output, and 0 keeps the unlinked module unless --linked, --require-linked, --linked-output, or --split-runtime is given. |
| `MOLT_WASM_LOCALE_DECIMAL` | string | unset | `runtime/molt-wasm-host/src/wasi_env.rs` | Decimal separator string that molt-wasm-host and wasm/run_wasm.js place in the guest WASI environment; when none of MOLT_WASM_LOCALE_DECIMAL, MOLT_WASM_LOCALE_THOUSANDS, or MOLT_WASM_LOCALE_GROUPING is set the host fills it from the system locale (Intl.NumberFormat under Node), and setting any one of the three keeps the host from filling the others. |
| `MOLT_WASM_LOCALE_GROUPING` | int | unset | `runtime/molt-wasm-host/src/wasi_env.rs` | Digit-group size (for example 3) that molt-wasm-host and wasm/run_wasm.js place in the guest WASI environment; the host fills it from the system locale only when that locale has a thousands separator and none of the three MOLT_WASM_LOCALE_* names is already set. |
| `MOLT_WASM_LOCALE_THOUSANDS` | string | unset | `runtime/molt-wasm-host/src/wasi_env.rs` | Thousands separator string that molt-wasm-host and wasm/run_wasm.js place in the guest WASI environment; the host fills it from the system locale only when that locale has a non-empty separator and none of the three MOLT_WASM_LOCALE_* names is already set. |
| `MOLT_WASM_MANIFEST_PATH` | path | unset | `runtime/molt-wasm-host/src/path_resolver.rs` | Runtime manifest that molt-wasm-host and wasm/run_wasm.js execute when no manifest argument is given; the path must end in .json, the default is dist/manifest.json under the current directory (../dist/manifest.json beside run_wasm.js), and tools/bench_wasm.py sets it for its runner children. |
| `MOLT_WASM_MAX_STACK` | int | `8388608` | `runtime/molt-wasm-host/src/engine.rs` | Maximum wasm stack in bytes for the molt-wasm-host engine; the value must be a positive integer that fits usize and leaves room for 131072 bytes of async-stack headroom, otherwise the host fails to start; default 8388608. |
| `MOLT_WASM_MIN_PAGES` | int | `64` | `runtime/molt-backend-wasm/src/wasm/module_abi/host_surface.rs` | Floor on the minimum page count (64 KiB pages) of the imported linear memory in wasm output; the backend uses the larger of this value and the pages the data segments need, and a non-numeric value falls back to 64. |
| `MOLT_WASM_MODULE_CHUNK_OPS` | int | `2000` | `src/molt/cli/frontend_pipeline.py` | Maximum ops per module-initialization chunk for wasm targets; the frontend splits module init into chunks of this size, 0 disables chunking, negative values clamp to 0, and a non-integer value warns and uses 2000. |
| `MOLT_WASM_NATIVE_EH` | bool | `1` | `runtime/molt-backend-wasm/src/wasm_options.rs` | Native wasm exception handling (tag section with try_table, catch, and throw) in backend output; enabled unless the value is exactly 0. |
| `MOLT_WASM_OPT` | path | unset | `src/molt/wasm_optimizer_identity.py` | Path of the wasm-opt executable for post-link WASM optimization; a non-empty value is an explicit pin, and an unusable pin stops resolution instead of falling back. When unset, wasm-opt comes from PATH, then from the manifest-owned Binaryen release under MOLT_TARGET_ROOT/toolchains. The molt-wasm-ci workflow sets it to the provisioned Binaryen's wasm-opt. The MOLT_WASM_OPT stem separately scopes the guard limits of wasm-opt runs. |
| `MOLT_WASM_POLL_DEBUG` | bool | `0` | `runtime/molt-runtime/src/async_rt/poll.rs` | Set to 1 to print each async poll function address, with its normalized wasm table address when they differ, to stderr from the wasm32 runtime; any other value is off and native builds never read it. |
| `MOLT_WASM_PRECOMPILED` | bool | `0` | `runtime/molt-wasm-host/src/precompiled.rs` | Set to 1 to make molt-wasm-host load host-produced .molt.cwasm containers for the main and runtime modules instead of compiling them at load time; 0 or unset compiles, and any other value is an error. |
| `MOLT_WASM_PRECOMPILED_PATH` | path | unset | `src/molt/cli/wasm_deployment.py` | Path of the main module's precompiled container: molt-wasm-host reads it as the .molt.cwasm to load (and molt-wasm-host --precompile writes it), and molt deploy uses it as the cwasm output path; an empty value is an error, and when unset the host uses <main module>.molt.cwasm beside the source. |
| `MOLT_WASM_PRECOMPILED_RUNTIME_PATH` | path | unset | `src/molt/cli/wasm_deployment.py` | Path of the runtime module's precompiled container: molt-wasm-host reads it as the .molt.cwasm to load (and molt-wasm-host --precompile writes it), and molt deploy uses it as the runtime cwasm output path; an empty value is an error, and when unset the host uses <runtime module>.molt.cwasm beside the source. |
| `MOLT_WASM_RUNTIME_DIR` | path | unset | `src/molt/cli/build_output_layout.py` | Directory that holds the wasm runtime artifacts (molt_runtime.wasm and molt_runtime_reloc.wasm) for source-checkout builds and the wasm tools; when unset Molt uses <MOLT_EXT_ROOT>/wasm if that directory exists, else <project root>/wasm, and an installed Molt rejects the variable because it ships its own runtime cells. |
| `MOLT_WASM_STAGE_AUDIT` | bool | `0` | `runtime/molt-backend-wasm/src/wasm_plan/stage_audit.rs` | Set to 1 to stream wasm backend stage audits to stderr (module emission and finalization stages with byte sizes) and to enable the TIR module-phase and drop-phase audits as well; any other value is off. |
| `MOLT_WASM_TABLE_BASE` | int | unset | `src/molt/cli/backend_compile.py` | Function-table base index (u32) shared by the wasm backend and the wasm32 runtime: molt build strips any inherited value and sets it for the backend from the bound runtime layout, tools/bench_wasm.py sets it from the runtime's table minimum, and molt-wasm-host, wasm/run_wasm.js, and the browser host pass the detected table base to the guest environment only when it is unset, where the runtime reads it as a positive integer; values that do not parse fall back to the built-in default. |
| `MOLT_WASM_TAIL_CALL` | bool | `0` | `runtime/molt-backend-wasm/src/wasm_options.rs` | Set to 1, true, TRUE, on, or ON to emit return_call tail calls (wasm tail-call proposal) in backend output; off by default until the target feature probe proves support. |
| `MOLT_WASM_TRACE` | bool | `0` | `wasm/run_wasm.js` | Set to 1 to make wasm/run_wasm.js print each molt_runtime import call with its argument types and converted arguments to stderr; any other value is off. |
| `MOLT_WASM_TRACE_EXIT` | bool | `0` | `wasm/run_wasm.js` | Set to 1 to make wasm/run_wasm.js print each WASI proc_exit call with its exit code, module path, and a JavaScript stack trace to stderr; any other value is off. |
| `MOLT_WASM_TRACE_FILE` | path | unset | `wasm/run_wasm.js` | Path of a file to which wasm/run_wasm.js appends trace marks (proc_exit codes and, with the matching flags, WASI fd_close, fd_write, and os_close events); unset disables the marks, and write errors are ignored. |
| `MOLT_WASM_TRACE_I32_AT` | int | unset | `wasm/run_wasm.js` | Linear-memory byte address whose little-endian u32 value wasm/run_wasm.js prints at trace points when MOLT_WASM_TRACE_RUN=1; unset, non-integer, negative, or out-of-range addresses print nothing. |
| `MOLT_WASM_TRACE_ISOLATE_IMPORT` | bool | `0` | `wasm/run_wasm.js` | Set to 1 to make wasm/run_wasm.js print each isolate_import phase with its module id and result or error to stderr; any other value is off. |
| `MOLT_WASM_TRACE_OS_CLOSE` | bool | `0` | `wasm/run_wasm.js` | Set to 1 to make wasm/run_wasm.js record an os_close:<fd> mark for each guest os_close call in the MOLT_WASM_TRACE_FILE file; without that file nothing is written, and any other value is off. |
| `MOLT_WASM_TRACE_RUN` | bool | `0` | `wasm/run_wasm.js` | Set to 1 to make wasm/run_wasm.js print run-stage diagnostics to stderr (instantiation steps, host export calls, traceback formatting failures) and to arm the table-slot, table-range, table-diff, and i32 trace probes; any other value is off. |
| `MOLT_WASM_TRACE_SOCKET_HOST` | bool | `0` | `wasm/run_wasm.js` | Set to 1 to make wasm/run_wasm.js print socket-host operations (bind, listen, and address decoding with handles and decoded addresses) to stderr; any other value is off. |
| `MOLT_WASM_TRACE_TABLE_DIFF` | bool | `0` | `wasm/run_wasm.js` | Set to 1 to make wasm/run_wasm.js snapshot the function table and print up to 20 changed slots between trace points when MOLT_WASM_TRACE_RUN=1; any other value is off. |
| `MOLT_WASM_TRACE_TABLE_RANGE` | string | unset | `wasm/run_wasm.js` | Function-table slot range start:end (end optional) whose state, name, and length wasm/run_wasm.js prints at trace points when MOLT_WASM_TRACE_RUN=1; unset or an invalid range prints nothing. |
| `MOLT_WASM_TRACE_TABLE_SLOT` | int | unset | `wasm/run_wasm.js` | Function-table slot index whose state, name, and length wasm/run_wasm.js prints at trace points when MOLT_WASM_TRACE_RUN=1; unset or a negative or non-numeric value prints nothing. |
| `MOLT_WASM_TRACE_WASI` | bool | `0` | `wasm/browser_host.js` | Set to 1 to make wasm/browser_host.js print browser WASI events (the guest environment, proc_exit, proc_raise, and file-descriptor operations) to the console; it is read only when a process.env object exists, and any other value is off. |
| `MOLT_WASM_TRACE_WASI_IO` | bool | `0` | `wasm/run_wasm.js` | Set to 1 to make wasm/run_wasm.js wrap WASI fd_close and fd_write and record their fd and return code as marks in the MOLT_WASM_TRACE_FILE file; without that file nothing is written, and any other value is off. |
| `MOLT_WASM_TRACE_WASI_IO_STACK` | bool | `0` | `wasm/run_wasm.js` | Set to 1 to add a JavaScript stack trace to each fd_close mark and each failing fd_write mark that MOLT_WASM_TRACE_WASI_IO=1 writes to the MOLT_WASM_TRACE_FILE file; it has no effect without that flag, and any other value is off. |
| `MOLT_WASM_TRAP_ON_EXIT` | bool | `0` | `wasm/run_wasm.js` | Set to 1 to make wasm/run_wasm.js throw a JavaScript error on WASI proc_exit instead of letting the guest exit, so the exit site surfaces as a trap with a stack; any other value is off. |
| `MOLT_WASM_WS_BUFFER_MAX` | int | `1048576` | `wasm/run_wasm.js` | Maximum WebSocket bufferedAmount in bytes before wasm/run_wasm.js stops reporting a socket as write-ready and returns EWOULDBLOCK from sends; parsed with parseInt, a non-numeric value yields NaN and never marks a socket write-ready; default 1048576. |
| `MOLT_WORKER_CMD` | string | unset | `src/molt_accel/decorator.py` | Whitespace-split command line that starts a molt-worker process for molt_accel, molt-wasm-host, and wasm/run_wasm.js database offload (for example molt-worker --stdio --exports <manifest>); when unset the readers look for molt-worker or molt_worker on PATH with the packaged default exports, the retired MOLT_WASM_DB_WORKER_CMD takes precedence in the host and run_wasm.js, and bench/scripts/run_stack.sh sets it for the demo stack. |
| `MOLT_WORKER_EXPORTS` | path | unset | `runtime/molt-wasm-host/src/path_resolver.rs` | Path of the worker exports manifest JSON that molt-wasm-host and wasm/run_wasm.js hand to the database worker; a path that does not exist is ignored, the retired MOLT_WASM_DB_EXPORTS takes precedence, and the fallback is src/molt_accel/default_exports.json then demo/molt_worker_app/molt_exports.json (relative to the current directory for the host and to the script directory for run_wasm.js). |
| `MOLT_WORKER_MAX_QUEUE` | int | `64` | `runtime/molt-worker/src/main.rs` | Request queue depth for molt-worker; --max-queue overrides it, values that are not positive integers fall back to 64, and bench/scripts/run_demo_bench.py records it in the bench artifact. |
| `MOLT_WORKER_RUNTIME` | enum: `sync`, `async` | `sync` | `runtime/molt-worker/src/main.rs` | molt-worker execution runtime, sync or async (case-insensitive, --runtime overrides it); an unknown value warns and uses sync, and Postgres mode (MOLT_DB_POSTGRES_DSN) requires async. |
| `MOLT_WORKER_THREADS` | int | unset | `runtime/molt-worker/src/main.rs` | Synchronous worker thread count for molt-worker; --threads overrides it, values that are not positive integers are ignored, when unset the worker uses the available CPU parallelism (4 when unknown), and bench/scripts/run_demo_bench.py records it in the bench artifact. |
| `MOLT_WORKER_WIRE` | enum: `json`, `msgpack` | unset | `src/molt_accel/decorator.py` | Wire codec for the molt_accel worker client, json or msgpack; when it and the retired MOLT_WIRE are unset the client uses msgpack if the msgpack package is installed, else json, asking for msgpack without the package is an error, and bench/scripts/run_demo_bench.py records it in the bench artifact. |

## Developer variables

Set these when you work on Molt itself: the dev wrappers, proof queue, benchmarks, and guards under `tools/`.

| Variable | Kind | Default | Read by | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `MOLT_AGENT_ID` | string | unset | `tools/agent_coordination.py` | Agent identity written into a coordination task record when no --agent argument is given; unset falls back to MOLT_SESSION_ID, then to agent-<task>-<pid>. |
| `MOLT_BENCH_CODON_TAQ_FILE` | path | unset | `tools/bench.py` | Input TAQ data file for the Codon benchmarks in tools/bench.py; unset uses bench/friends/repos/codon_benchmarks/bench/data/taq.txt when present, else a generated sample under the bench temp root. |
| `MOLT_BENCH_CODON_WORD_FILE` | path | unset | `tools/bench.py` | Word-count input file for the Codon benchmarks in tools/bench.py; unset uses the resolved Codon TAQ file. |
| `MOLT_BENCH_PYODIDE_CMD` | string | unset | `tools/bench.py` | Shell command prefix, split with shlex, that runs a script under Pyodide for tools/bench.py --pyodide; --pyodide-cmd overrides it, and unset skips the Pyodide lane. |
| `MOLT_BENCH_TMP_ROOT` | path | unset | `tools/bench.py` | Scratch directory for bench temporaries; unset uses <MOLT_DIFF_TMPDIR or TMPDIR>/bench, else <bench artifact root>/tmp/bench, and tools/bench.py records the resolved value in its canonical environment. |
| `MOLT_BENCH_WS` | bool | `0` | `tools/bench.py` | Set exactly to 1 to include the websocket wait benchmark in tools/bench.py, the same as --ws. |
| `MOLT_BINDING_PROFILE_SOURCE_ROOT` | path | unset | `tools/profile_python_binding_flow.py` | Implementation checkout whose src/ tools/profile_python_binding_flow.py imports and profiles; unset uses the repo root, and the tool passes the resolved root to the child run it launches. |
| `MOLT_BIN_PATH` | path | unset | `tools/parity_gate.py` | Path of the molt executable tools/parity_gate.py runs; unset tries molt on PATH, then python -m molt.cli from the repo root. |
| `MOLT_BOLT_TELEMETRY_JSON` | path | unset | `tools/bolt_optimize.sh` | File where tools/bolt_optimize.sh writes its BOLT timing telemetry as JSON; unset writes none, and tools/native_link_benchmark.py sets it to a hidden file beside the output binary. |
| `MOLT_CACHE_MAX_AGE_DAYS` | int | `30` | `tools/molt_cache_prune.py` | Age in days after which tools/molt_cache_prune.py evicts cache entries when --max-age-days is absent; molt dx projects the default 30 into its environment. |
| `MOLT_CACHE_MAX_GB` | float | `30` | `tools/molt_cache_prune.py` | Cache size budget in GB that tools/molt_cache_prune.py prunes down to when --max-gb is absent; molt dx projects the default 30 into its environment. |
| `MOLT_CACHE_PRUNE` | bool | `1` | `tools/throughput_env.sh` | Runs tools/molt_cache_prune.py against MOLT_CACHE (bounded by MOLT_CACHE_MAX_GB and MOLT_CACHE_MAX_AGE_DAYS) when throughput_env.sh applies the throughput environment; only the exact value 0 skips the prune, default 1. |
| `MOLT_CARGO_TEST_TRUTH_RUN_ID` | string | unset | `tools/run_cargo_test_truth.py` | Identity of the Cargo test truth run, which names the evidence directory under the runs root; it must match ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$ or the run fails, and unset means <UTC timestamp>-<pid>. |
| `MOLT_CI_CARGO_BUILD_GB_PER_JOB` | float | unset | `tools/ci_resource_env.py` | Memory in gigabytes the CI resource planner budgets per parallel cargo build job; it must be a positive finite number or planning raises ValueError, and unset uses the receipt-calibrated value from config/ci_resource_policy.toml. |
| `MOLT_CI_MAX_CARGO_BUILD_JOBS` | int | unset | `tools/ci_resource_env.py` | Upper bound on parallel cargo build jobs the CI resource planner may schedule; it must be a positive integer or planning raises ValueError, and unset uses max_jobs from config/ci_resource_policy.toml. |
| `MOLT_CODEC` | enum: `msgpack`, `cbor`, `json` | `msgpack` | `tools/bench.py` | Structured codec the bench, molt_diff and conformance harnesses pass to the build server and to `molt build --codec`; default msgpack when unset. |
| `MOLT_COMPAT_FAULT_INJECT` | list | unset | `tools/compat/backends.py` | Comma-separated backend names (compared lowercase) whose stdout the compat diff harness perturbs with a <MOLT_COMPAT_FAULT_INJECT::backend> marker line so the cross-backend divergence proof sees a synthetic wrong answer; empty or unset injects nothing. |
| `MOLT_COMPAT_SCRATCH_ROOT` | path | unset | `tools/compat/backends.py` | Scratch directory for cross-backend compat builds, consulted only when no differential output root is selected (the layout then sets it to <root>/compat-scratch for children); ~ expands, and unset means <MOLT_EXT_ROOT or repo>/tmp/compat_backends. |
| `MOLT_COMPILE_GUARD_DIR` | path | unset | `tools/compile_governor.py` | Directory holding the compile governor's slot lock files; ~ expands, and unset means <build state root for the Cargo target dir>/compile_guard. |
| `MOLT_COMPILE_GUARD_ENABLED` | bool | `1` | `tools/compile_governor.py` | Enables the compile governor that limits concurrent builds by slot locks, load and active compiler processes; 1/true/yes/on or 0/false/no/off (case-insensitive), other spellings keep the default on. |
| `MOLT_COMPILE_GUARD_MAX_ACTIVE_PROCS` | int | unset | `tools/compile_governor.py` | Maximum number of active compiler processes the compile governor tolerates before it waits for a slot; non-integer values fall back and values below 1 clamp to 1, and unset uses the resource-pressure plan or max slots times 3. |
| `MOLT_COMPILE_GUARD_MAX_LOAD` | float | unset | `tools/compile_governor.py` | One-minute load average above which the compile governor waits before granting a slot; negative values clamp to 0, non-numeric values fall back, and unset means the larger of max slots and cpu_count times 1.25. |
| `MOLT_COMPILE_GUARD_MAX_SLOTS` | int | unset | `tools/compile_governor.py` | Number of concurrent compile slots the compile governor hands out; non-integer values fall back and values below 1 clamp to 1, and unset uses the resource-pressure plan (baseline 2). |
| `MOLT_COMPILE_GUARD_POLL_SEC` | float | `0.5` | `tools/compile_governor.py` | Seconds the compile governor sleeps between slot acquisition attempts; values below 0.05 clamp to 0.05 and non-numeric values fall back to 0.5. |
| `MOLT_COMPILE_GUARD_WAIT_SEC` | float | `180` | `tools/compile_governor.py` | Seconds the compile governor waits for a free slot before it gives up; negative values clamp to 0 and non-numeric values fall back to 180. |
| `MOLT_DEMO_DB_PATH` | path | unset | `bench/scripts/run_stack.sh` | SQLite database file for the Django demo stack; when set, run_stack.sh seeds it and derives MOLT_DB_SQLITE_PATH from it, the demo views read it for /baseline and /offload, and the bench records it, while unset means no SQLite-backed demo reads. |
| `MOLT_DEMO_METRICS_PATH` | path | unset | `bench/scripts/run_stack.sh` | JSONL file that the demo Django server appends per-request worker metrics to and the demo bench summarizes; default <MOLT_DEMO_RUN_DIR>/molt_demo_metrics.jsonl, and run_stack.sh refuses a file that already exists. |
| `MOLT_DEMO_RUN_DIR` | path | unset | `bench/scripts/run_demo_bench.py` | Exclusive demo run directory, which must be a new bench/results/demo-runs/<run-id> path with a lowercase [a-z0-9-] id of 8-128 characters; run_stack.sh binds it before startup, CI sets one per job attempt, and unset creates a fresh UUID directory. |
| `MOLT_DEMO_STACK_TIMEOUT_SEC` | float | unset | `bench/scripts/run_stack.sh` | Wall-clock limit in seconds for the guarded demo stack run, which run_stack.sh passes to guarded_exec as --timeout-env; MOLT_BENCH_TIMEOUT_SEC and MOLT_TEST_PROCESS_TIMEOUT_SEC take precedence, and unset, non-numeric, or non-positive means no limit. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_ALLOW_RUSTC_WRAPPER` | bool | `0` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Set to 1, true, yes, or on to let differential runs keep RUSTC_WRAPPER and sccache; the harness strips them otherwise, and the dx run-context sets it to 1 by default. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_BACKEND_DAEMON` | bool | unset | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Forces backend daemon mode on (1, true, yes, on) or off (0, false, no, off) for differential runs; unset falls back to MOLT_BACKEND_DAEMON, then to off on macOS and on elsewhere. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_BATCH_COMPILE_SERVER` | bool | `0` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Routes differential test builds through one long-lived molt internal-batch-build-server child instead of a fresh build subprocess per test; 1/true/yes/on enables it, 0/false/no/off disables it, default off. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_BATCH_COMPILE_SERVER_DISABLE_AFTER_FAILURES` | int | `2` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Number of consecutive batch compile server failures before a differential worker puts the server in cooldown; values below 1 clamp to 1 and non-integer values use 2. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_BATCH_COMPILE_SERVER_DISABLE_COOLDOWN_SEC` | float | `30` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Seconds a differential worker keeps the batch compile server disabled after the failure threshold; negative values clamp to 0 (no cooldown) and non-numeric values use 30. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_BATCH_COMPILE_SERVER_STRICT` | bool | `0` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Makes a batch compile server failure a build failure (status build_batch_server_error, return code 127) instead of a warning plus subprocess fallback; 1/true/yes/on enables it, 0/false/no/off disables it, default off. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_BATCH_COMPILE_SERVER_TIMEOUT_SEC` | float | unset | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Seconds tests/molt_diff.py waits for one batch compile server build request or for server shutdown; a positive number is used as given, otherwise the resolved build timeout applies, and 60 when no build timeout is set. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_BUILD_LOCK_MAX_AGE_SEC` | int | `43200` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Age in seconds after which tests/molt_diff.py deletes an empty build-lock sentinel under <state root>/build_locks at run start; 0 or a negative value disables age pruning, non-numeric values fall back to 43200 (12 hours). |
| `MOLT_DIFF_BUILD_LOCK_MAX_FILES` | int | `4096` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Maximum number of build-lock sentinels tests/molt_diff.py keeps under <state root>/build_locks, deleting the oldest beyond that count at run start; 0 or a negative value disables count pruning, non-numeric values fall back to 4096. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_BUILD_PROFILE` | enum: `dev`, `release` | `dev` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Build profile the differential harness forwards to molt build when --build-profile is not given; dev or release, default dev, and any other spelling raises ValueError. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_BUILD_TIMEOUT` | float | unset | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Seconds allowed for one differential test's Molt build; a positive number is used as given, otherwise the limit is twice MOLT_DIFF_TIMEOUT with a 300-second floor, and there is no build limit when MOLT_DIFF_TIMEOUT is also unset. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_CAPABILITIES` | list | `fs,env,time,random` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Comma-separated capability names the differential harness and parity gate pass to compiled programs as MOLT_CAPABILITIES; the harness falls back to MOLT_CAPABILITIES before the default fs,env,time,random, and the verified subset removes it. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_CARGO_TARGET_DIR` | path | unset | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Shared Cargo target directory for differential builds; unset falls back to CARGO_TARGET_DIR and then a target derived from the artifact root, the dx run-context sets it to CARGO_TARGET_DIR, and molt setup warns when a source checkout leaves it unset. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_CLEAR_DYLD_GUARD` | bool | `0` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Truthy 1/true/yes/on makes tests/molt_diff.py delete the global dyld guard marker at run start and skip the preemptive dyld quarantine; an explicit MOLT_DIFF_DYLD_PREEMPTIVE takes precedence, default off. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_DAEMON_MAX_RSS_KB` | int | `2500000` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | RSS threshold in kilobytes above which tests/molt_diff.py terminates a verified backend daemon it owns during its pruning passes on POSIX hosts; 0 or a negative value disables RSS-based pruning, non-numeric values fall back to 2500000. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_DAEMON_STALE_SEC` | int | `600` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Minimum process age in seconds before tests/molt_diff.py terminates a backend daemon that no longer answers a socket ping; values below 60 are raised to 60, non-numeric values fall back to 600. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_DISABLE_DAEMON_ON_DYLD` | bool | `1` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Controls whether tests/molt_diff.py sets MOLT_BACKEND_DAEMON=0 and MOLT_DIFF_FORCE_NO_CACHE=1 for the rest of the run after a dyld unknown-imports incident or a preemptive dyld quarantine; 1/true/yes/on enables it, any other non-empty value disables it, default on. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_DYLD_GUARD_RUNS` | int | `1` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Number of later diff runs that stay in dyld quarantine after an incident writes the global dyld guard marker; values below 1 are raised to 1, non-numeric values fall back to 1. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_DYLD_GUARD_TTL_SEC` | int | `21600` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Age in seconds after which tests/molt_diff.py treats the global dyld guard marker as expired and clears it instead of quarantining the run; values below 60 are raised to 60, non-numeric values fall back to 21600 (6 hours). |
| `MOLT_DIFF_DYLD_LOCAL_FALLBACK` | bool | unset | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Enables (1, true, yes, on) or disables (0, false, no, off) the local temp-directory retry and quarantine lanes after a dyld import-format incident in differential runs; unset means on for macOS and off elsewhere. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_DYLD_LOCAL_ROOT` | path | unset | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Root directory for the local dyld quarantine lanes of differential runs; unset uses <system temp dir>/molt_diff_dyld. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_DYLD_PREEMPTIVE` | bool | unset | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Forces the preemptive dyld quarantine decision at run start: 1/true/yes/on quarantines, 0/false/no/off skips, and when unset tests/molt_diff.py consults MOLT_DIFF_CLEAR_DYLD_GUARD and then the dyld guard marker's age and remaining runs. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_DYLD_PREFLIGHT` | bool | unset | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Enables the otool -l preflight that checks a freshly built test binary for dyld unknown imports format or malformed load command corruption before it runs; 1/true/yes/on enables it, 0/false/no/off disables it, and when unset the check runs on macOS only. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_FAILURES` | path | unset | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Failure queue file the differential harness writes when --failures-output is not given and the debug verify checks read for probe linkage; unset uses <MOLT_DIFF_ROOT>/failures.txt. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_FORCE_NO_CACHE` | bool | `0` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Forces (1, true, yes, on) or disables (0, false, no, off) --no-cache for differential runs; default off (cache enabled), and the harness and mutation_test set it to 1 for dyld-incident retries and mutant runs. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_FORCE_REBUILD` | bool | `0` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Truthy 1/true/yes/on forces a Molt rebuild for every differential test build; tests/molt_diff.py also sets it to 1 itself after a dyld incident when MOLT_DIFF_FORCE_REBUILD_ON_DYLD is on, default off. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_FORCE_REBUILD_ON_DYLD` | bool | `1` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Controls whether a dyld unknown-imports incident or a preemptive dyld quarantine also sets MOLT_DIFF_FORCE_REBUILD=1 for the rest of the run; 1/true/yes/on enables it, 0/false/no/off disables it, default on. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_GLOB` | string | `*.py` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Glob pattern tests/molt_diff.py passes to test_policy.collect_test_files when it expands a directory target into test files; default *.py, so **/*.py selects a recursive sweep. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_GUEST_OUTPUT_ROOT` | path | unset | `tools/compat/diff_output_layout.py` | Existing absolute directory (not a volume root) that holds differential guest temporary output, Cargo target, and adapter scratch; it requires canonical MOLT_EXT_ROOT and the build-capacity check, and unset keeps guest output under the canonical artifact root. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_HELPER_STALE_SEC` | int | `1200` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Elapsed seconds after which tests/molt_diff.py prunes a diff build helper process that has no live diff harness ancestor; values below 60 are raised to 60, non-numeric values fall back to 1200. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_KEEP` | bool | `0` | `tools/compat/diff_output_layout.py` | Set to 1, true, yes, or on to keep per-test differential artifacts and fresh adapter leaves after each run; default removes them. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_KEEP_ISOLATED_RETRY` | bool | `0` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Truthy 1/true/yes/on keeps the isolated target and build-state directories after an isolated retry of a differential test instead of retiring them; default off. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_LOG_PASSES` | bool | `0` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Set to 1, true, yes, or on to keep per-test and aggregate logs for passing differential tests when --log-dir is used; default prunes pass logs. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_MAX_JOBS` | int | unset | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Hard cap on the job count tests/molt_diff.py auto-selects when --jobs is not passed; only a string of digits is honoured, 0 counts as 1, and when unset the count is the CPU count bounded by the memory-guard scheduler budget. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_MAX_RSS_KB` | int | unset | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Fallback spelling of MOLT_DIFF_FAIL_RSS_KB, read only when that name is empty: a peak RSS threshold in kilobytes that fails a differential test's build or run phase, with unset, non-numeric or non-positive values disabling the check. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_MAX_TASKS_PER_CHILD` | int | `0` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Number of differential tests one ProcessPoolExecutor worker runs before tests/molt_diff.py replaces it (max_tasks_per_child); 0, a negative value or non-numeric text keeps each worker for the whole run. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_MEASURE_RSS` | bool | `1` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Collects per-test RSS metrics under <output root>/metrics in differential runs unless set to 0, false, no, or off; unset or any other value measures, and nightly CI and throughput_matrix set it to 1. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_MEMORY_GUARD_EVENTS_JSONL` | path | unset | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Path of the JSONL file that receives memory-guard events such as run_started, tripped and subprocess_guard_tripped; run_diff in tests/molt_diff.py sets it to <diff root>/memory_guard/events.jsonl at run start for its worker processes, so a hand-set value reaches only diff_test calls that bypass run_diff, and when unset that same default path is used. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_MEMORY_GUARD_GLOBAL_SAMPLES_JSONL` | path | unset | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Path of the JSONL file that receives memory-guard RSS sample records when MOLT_DIFF_MEMORY_GUARD_WRITE_SAMPLES is on; run_diff in tests/molt_diff.py sets it to <diff root>/memory_guard/global_samples.jsonl at run start for its worker processes, and when unset that same default path is used. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_MEMORY_GUARD_MAX_EVENT_MB` | float | `1` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Size cap in MiB for each memory-guard event JSONL file under MOLT_DIFF_ROOT/memory_guard before the harness rotates it once; non-numeric values use 1, and 0 or a negative value disables rotation. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_MEMORY_GUARD_MAX_SAMPLE_MB` | float | `2` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Size cap in MiB for the memory-guard global_samples.jsonl file under MOLT_DIFF_ROOT/memory_guard before the harness rotates it once; non-numeric values use 2, and 0 or a negative value disables rotation. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_MEMORY_GUARD_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_SEC` | float | `1` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Minimum seconds between memory-guard RSS sample records written by tests/molt_diff.py; values are clamped to the range 0.001 to 60, and unset, non-numeric or non-positive values fall back to 1. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_MEMORY_GUARD_STREAM` | enum: `0`, `false`, `no`, `off`, `none`, `1`, `true`, `yes`, `on`, `stderr`, `stdout`, `json`, `json-stdout`, `json-stderr`, `stderr-json` | unset | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Live NDJSON stream target for the differential memory guard; stderr (also 1, true, yes, on), stdout, json, json-stdout, json-stderr or stderr-json turn it on, and unset, 0, false, no, off, none or any unknown value keep it off. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_MEMORY_GUARD_WRITE_SAMPLES` | bool | `1` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Whether the differential memory guard writes sample telemetry under MOLT_DIFF_ROOT/memory_guard; 1, true, yes, on or unset writes samples, and 0, false, no or off keeps only trip and event evidence plus the live stream. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_MEM_PER_JOB_GB` | float | unset | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Gigabytes of memory the differential scheduler budgets per parallel job when it auto-selects the job count; a positive value is capped at the process-tree RSS limit, non-positive values are ignored, and when unset the budget is the global RSS limit divided by the CPU count, clamped between 1 and 8 and never above the tree limit. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_METADATA_PROBE_TIMEOUT_SEC` | float | `5` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Seconds tests/molt_diff.py allows each interpreter metadata probe, such as the packaging import check that picks the molt CLI Python; non-numeric or non-positive values fall back to 5. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_MOLT_PYTHON` | path | unset | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Executable path of the Python interpreter tests/molt_diff.py uses to run the molt CLI and the batch compile server; it must name exactly one executable or the harness raises PythonInterpreterError, and when unset the harness probes .venv/bin/python3 and .venv/bin/python (.venv/Scripts/python.exe on Windows) and then sys.executable for the first one that imports packaging. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_ORDER` | enum: `auto`, `name`, `size-asc`, `size-desc` | `auto` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Order in which tests/molt_diff.py schedules the collected test files; name keeps collection order, size-asc and size-desc sort by file size, auto picks size-desc when jobs is above 1 and name otherwise, and unknown spellings fall back to auto. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_PRUNE_EVERY` | int | `32` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Number of completed differential tests between pruning passes that remove orphan diff workers, orphan build helpers and oversized or unresponsive backend daemons during a parallel run; 0 or a negative value disables the periodic passes, non-numeric values fall back to 32. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_PYTHON` | path | unset | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Explicit CPython interpreter the differential harness uses as the reference side when a --python-version target is given, and the first candidate baseline interpreter for the Rust correctness tests; tools/verified_subset.py sets it to its own interpreter, and when unset the harness resolves the target version itself. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_QUARANTINE_ON_DYLD` | bool | `0` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Whether a dyld import-format incident moves the differential run to a cold quarantine Cargo target and build-state directory; 1, true, yes or on enables it, and unset, 0, false, no or off keeps the shared target to avoid cold rebuilds. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_RETRY_DYLD` | bool | `1` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Controls whether a differential test whose stderr shows dyld unknown imports format is retried with the backend daemon disabled; 1/true/yes/on enables it, any other non-empty value disables it, default on. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_RETRY_ISOLATED` | bool | `1` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Controls whether a differential test with a persistent dyld failure or backend daemon/cache failure is retried in an isolated target and build-state directory with --no-cache; 1/true/yes/on enables it, any other non-empty value disables it, default on. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_RETRY_OOM` | bool | `1` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Whether the differential harness retries OOM-killed tests once with --jobs 1; 1, true, yes, on or unset retries, and 0, false, no or off disables the retry. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_RSS_TOP` | int | `5` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Number of top RSS offenders tests/molt_diff.py lists for the build and run phases in its end-of-run summary when MOLT_DIFF_MEASURE_RSS is on; non-numeric values fall back to 5. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_RUN_ID` | string | unset | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Identifier for one differential run, used in scratch-lease names, dyld-quarantine directories, RSS records and cleanup receipts; tests/molt_diff.py generates <UTC timestamp>_<pid> when unset and exports the value to its workers, and tools/compat uses adhoc when it is empty. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_RUN_LOCK_POLL_SEC` | float | `0.5` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Seconds between attempts to acquire the shared differential run lock at <state root>/diff_run.lock; values below 0.05 are raised to 0.05, non-numeric values fall back to 0.5. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_RUN_LOCK_WAIT_SEC` | float | `900` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Seconds tests/molt_diff.py waits for the shared differential run lock at <state root>/diff_run.lock before it fails with a lock timeout; negative values count as 0, non-numeric values fall back to 900. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_STDLIB_PROFILE` | enum: `micro`, `full` | unset | `tools/compat/backends.py` | Stdlib profile forwarded to molt build for the Molt side of a differential run; micro or full, any other value is an error, unset leaves the build default, and a test whose metadata names a profile must match the selected one. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_SUMMARY` | path | unset | `tests/molt_diff.py` | File path for the JSON summary of a differential run; when unset tests/molt_diff.py writes MOLT_DIFF_ROOT/summary.json. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_TIMEOUT` | float | unset | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Seconds allowed for one differential test's CPython and Molt run phases; a positive number is enforced and also seeds the build timeout default, while unset, non-numeric or non-positive values mean no run timeout. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_WARM_CACHE` | bool | `0` | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Truthy 1/true/yes/on makes tests/molt_diff.py build every selected test once to seed the shared MOLT_CACHE before the diff run, the same as --warm-cache; default off. |
| `MOLT_DISCOVERY_LLDB` | bool | `0` | `tools/native_numpy_discovery.sh` | Runs the native extension discovery driver under lldb --batch on macOS or gdb --batch elsewhere to capture a backtrace on a hard crash, when set to exactly 1; default 0 runs the driver directly. |

| `MOLT_WINDOWS_PROCESS_SNAPSHOT_TIMEOUT_SEC` | float | `5` | `tools/memory_guard_core/windows_snapshot.py` | Budget in seconds for the Windows process-table snapshot helper that the memory guard and process sentinels use; 0, false, off, no, or a non-positive number removes the budget, a non-numeric value uses 5, and exceeding the budget fails closed to an empty process table; default 5. |
| `MOLT_WITNESS_CACHE` | path | unset | `tools/witness_iter.py` | Directory for the persistent content-addressed frontend-lowering cache that tools/witness_iter.py exports as MOLT_CACHE to the witness drive; default witness-warm-cache in the checkout's Cargo target (molt.dx.project_cargo_target_dir), created when missing. |
| `MOLT_WITNESS_ITERATION` | bool | unset | `tools/pact_witness_acceptance.py` | Iteration-mode switch for witness runs; tools/pact_witness_acceptance.py requires it to be exactly 0 (the proof queue locks that value) and refuses to produce acceptance evidence when it is unset or any other value. |
| `MOLT_WITNESS_STATIC_TLS` | int | `1048576` | `tools/witness_iter.py` | Byte count for the glibc.rtld.optional_static_tls tunable that tools/witness_iter.py appends to GLIBC_TUNABLES for the native witness driver so a dlopen'ed harness with initial-exec TLS (mimalloc) can load; default 1048576. |
| `MOLT_WITNESS_WSL_DISTRO` | string | `MoltCodonUbuntu` | `tools/witness_iter.py` | Name of the WSL distribution that tools/witness_iter.py dispatches into when run on native Windows; default MoltCodonUbuntu. |
| `MOLT_WITNESS_WSL_REPO` | path | unset | `tools/witness_iter.py` | Repository path inside the WSL distribution that tools/witness_iter.py uses when dispatching from native Windows; when unset the tool translates the Windows repository path with wslpath -a. |
| `MOLT_WITNESS_WSL_TARGET` | path | `/root/.molt-witness-target` | `tools/witness_iter.py` | CARGO_TARGET_DIR inside the WSL distribution for the dispatched tools/witness_iter.py build, kept off the Windows tree; default /root/.molt-witness-target. |
| `MOLT_WORKER_CARGO_PROFILE` | string | `dev-fast` | `bench/scripts/run_stack.sh` | Cargo profile that bench/scripts/run_stack.sh uses to build molt-worker when no molt-worker is on PATH; default dev-fast. |
| `MOLT_WS_BENCH_ITERS` | int | `2000` | `tests/benchmarks/bench_ws_wait.py` | Number of websocket send/recv round trips tests/benchmarks/bench_ws_wait.py performs; the value must parse as an integer, default 2000. |
| `MOLT_WS_BENCH_SIZE` | int | `32` | `tests/benchmarks/bench_ws_wait.py` | Payload size in bytes of each websocket echo message in tests/benchmarks/bench_ws_wait.py; the value must parse as an integer, default 32. |
| `MOLT_WS_BENCH_URL` | string | unset | `tests/benchmarks/bench_ws_wait.py` | Websocket URL the tests/benchmarks/bench_ws_wait.py client connects to; when unset the benchmark starts its own echo server on 127.0.0.1 with an ephemeral port and connects to that. |

## CI variables

Set by the GitHub workflows (or as repository variables). They configure CI custody roots, pinned tool releases, and trust policy.

| Variable | Kind | Default | Read by | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `MOLT_CARGO_CACHE_KEY` | string | unset | `.github/actions/save-cargo-cache/action.yml` | The setup-project action writes the restored Cargo cache primary key here through GITHUB_ENV, and the save-cargo-cache action prunes and saves the Cargo dependency cache under that key only when the value is non-empty and the job runs on main. |
| `MOLT_CARGO_CACHE_TARGET` | path | unset | `tools/ci_cargo_cache.py` | Absolute Cargo target directory that `ci_cargo_cache.py configure` records in GITHUB_ENV (CARGO_TARGET_DIR, else RUNNER_TEMP/molt-cargo-target); the cache actions save and restore that path and `ci_cargo_cache.py prune` removes workspace crate artifacts beneath it before the save. |
| `MOLT_CI_EPHEMERAL_CUSTODY_ROOT` | path | unset | `src/molt/dx.py` | Per-run custody directory under RUNNER_TEMP that the setup-project action's first step writes to GITHUB_ENV; src/molt/dx.py treats a non-empty value as the hosted-checkout contract and fails closed unless GITHUB_ACTIONS, CI, the GitHub URLs, workspace and commit facts all agree, and unset means no hosted custody. |
| `MOLT_CI_RESOURCE_CPU_COUNT` | int | unset | `tools/ci_resource_env.py` | Exported to GITHUB_ENV by tools/ci_resource_env.py: the CPU count the CI resource plan was computed from, for inspection in later workflow steps. |
| `MOLT_CI_RESOURCE_PLAN_JSON` | string | unset | `tools/ci_resource_env.py` | Exported to GITHUB_ENV by tools/ci_resource_env.py: the full CI resource plan as compact JSON, for inspection in later workflow steps. |
| `MOLT_CI_RESOURCE_REASON` | string | unset | `tools/ci_resource_env.py` | Exported to GITHUB_ENV by tools/ci_resource_env.py: the one-line reason behind the CI resource plan, for inspection in later workflow steps. |
| `MOLT_QUINT_NPM_PACKAGE` | string | `@informalsystems/quint@0.32.0` | `.github/workflows/formal.yml` | npm package spec the formal workflow installs globally to get the Quint CLI; the workflow env map sets it to @informalsystems/quint@0.32.0. |
| `MOLT_QUINT_RUST_EVALUATOR_ASSET` | string | `quint_evaluator-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` | `.github/workflows/formal.yml` | Release asset file name of the Quint Rust evaluator tarball the formal workflow downloads from the informalsystems/quint GitHub release; the workflow env map sets it. |
| `MOLT_QUINT_RUST_EVALUATOR_SHA256` | string | `61755a09d5052d93a4e75e840059edfd0d3674aeda164b9d2464be3d6e21b1c2` | `.github/workflows/formal.yml` | Expected SHA-256 digest of the Quint Rust evaluator tarball; the formal workflow checks the download against it with sha256sum before it extracts the evaluator. |
| `MOLT_QUINT_RUST_EVALUATOR_VERSION` | string | `v0.6.0` | `.github/workflows/formal.yml` | Release tag of the Quint Rust evaluator the formal workflow downloads and installs under ~/.quint/rust-evaluator-<version>; the workflow env map sets it. |
| `MOLT_TRUSTED_PR_AUTHORS` | list | `adpena` | `.github/workflows/pr_trust_gate.yml` | GitHub repository variable with comma-separated GitHub logins whose pull requests and commit chains the PR trust gate and trust labeler accept; entries are trimmed, lowercased and matched as substrings; empty or unset means adpena. |
| `MOLT_TRUSTED_PR_LABEL` | string | `trusted-pr` | `.github/workflows/pr_trust_labeler.yml` | GitHub repository variable naming the label the PR trust labeler applies to pull requests from trusted authors; empty or unset means trusted-pr. |
| `MOLT_UNTRUSTED_PR_LABEL` | string | `untrusted-pr` | `.github/workflows/pr_trust_labeler.yml` | GitHub repository variable naming the label the PR trust labeler applies to pull requests from untrusted authors or forks; empty or unset means untrusted-pr. |
| `MOLT_VERIFIED_SUBSET_RUNNER` | string | unset | `tools/verified_subset.py` | GitHub runner label that the verified-subset workflow exports from its matrix; tools/verified_subset.py requires it to equal the coordinate's runner when it records the CI execution identity and raises ValueError otherwise; unset outside CI. |

## Internal variables

Set by one Molt process for a child it launches. Do not set these by hand; the parent owns the value.

| Variable | Kind | Default | Read by | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `MOLT_ASSERT_CHILD` | bool | `0` | `runtime/molt-runtime/src/call/function.rs` | The molt-runtime pending-exception trap test sets it to 1 for the child test process it spawns; the child test body runs only when it reads exactly 1, and nothing outside that test reads it. |
| `MOLT_BACKEND_COMPILER_FINGERPRINT` | string | unset | `runtime/molt-passes/src/tir/cache.rs` | molt build sets it to the admitted compiler fingerprint for the molt-backend child; the backend keys its TIR cache namespace on it instead of hashing its own executable, and the CLI folds it into the daemon config digest. |
| `MOLT_BACKEND_DAEMON_CONFIG_DIGEST` | string | unset | `runtime/molt-backend/src/backend_process/daemon/server/mod.rs` | molt sets it to the admitted config digest when it spawns the backend daemon; the daemon trims it, reports it as spawn_config_digest in health responses, and compares it with request digests. |
| `MOLT_BACKEND_DAEMON_SUITE_LEASE` | path | unset | `src/molt/backend_daemon_suite_custody.py` | tools/harness_memory_guard.py sets it to the suite daemon lease file it starts; molt's backend daemon custody reads it to allow persistent daemon paths, record the lease in the daemon identity and config digest, and transfer daemon process groups to the lease holder on POSIX. |
| `MOLT_BACKEND_MAX_PROCESS_RSS_GB` | int | unset | `runtime/molt-backend/src/backend_process/memory_guard.rs` | Gigabyte cap on the backend compiler process's committed memory; tools/memory_guard_core/process_custody.py sets it in the child environment from the guard RSS budget and the CLI forwards it in backend daemon requests, the backend process reads it as a whole number to install RLIMIT_DATA on Linux or a job-object memory limit on Windows, molt-tir reads it as a float memory-budget hint, and when unset the backend computes 16, 12, 8 or 4 from physical RAM of at least 64, 32, 16 or fewer GiB. |
| `MOLT_BACKEND_MEMORY_AVAILABLE_GB` | float | unset | `runtime/molt-passes/src/memory_budget.rs` | The memory guard sets it to the child's memory ceiling in GB (non-negative finite float); molt-backend and the TIR pipeline subtract MOLT_BACKEND_MEMORY_RESERVE_GB from it to size the in-memory TIR cache and the optimisation resource plan, reading MOLT_CLI_MEMORY_AVAILABLE_GB, MOLT_CLI_MEM_AVAILABLE_GB, MOLT_MEMORY_AVAILABLE_GB, and MOLT_MEM_AVAILABLE_GB as fallbacks when it is unset. |
| `MOLT_BENCH_DAEMON_CLEANUP_LOG` | path | unset | `tools/bench.py` | tools/bench.py sets it to <artifact root>/memory_guard/backend_daemon_cleanup.jsonl in the bench environment and appends one JSON event there per backend daemon prune; a relative path resolves against the repo root, and unset skips the log. |
| `MOLT_BENCH_DAEMON_CLEANUP_REASON` | string | `bench_prune` | `tools/bench.py` | tools/bench.py sets it to bench_start for the initial backend daemon prune and records the value as the reason field of the cleanup event; unset records bench_prune. |
| `MOLT_BUILD_VALIDITY_PROBE` | bool | unset | `src/molt/cli/native_binary.py` | molt build sets it to 1 in the environment of the freshly linked native binary during the opt-in smoke-exec probe so a program may exit early; no runtime code reads it. |
| `MOLT_BUNDLE_ROOT` | path | unset | `src/molt/source_root.py` | packaging/bootstrap.py sets it to the installed bundle root for the molt process it launches; molt reads it to recognise <bundle>/source as an installed compiler root that must carry a manifest. |
| `MOLT_CAPABILITY_POLICY_DIGEST` | string | unset | `runtime/molt-runtime/src/object/ops_sys.rs` | CapabilityManifest.to_env_vars in src/molt/capability_manifest.py sets it to the sha256:<64 lowercase hex> digest of the resolved capability policy for the program it launches, and molt_runtime_init_audit reads it to stamp audit records; a malformed value panics and an unset value records no digest. |
| `MOLT_CEXT_BENCH_CANDIDATE` | enum: `admitted`, `checked-nested` | `admitted` | `runtime/molt-runtime/src/cpython_abi_hooks.rs` | tools/benchmark_cext_trampoline.py sets it for each timed child, and the ignored cext trampoline benchmark test in cpython_abi_hooks.rs reads it to pick the candidate call path to time against the baseline; default admitted, any other spelling panics. |
| `MOLT_CEXT_BENCH_EXPECTED_PRIORITY` | int | unset | `runtime/molt-runtime/src/cpython_abi_hooks.rs` | tools/benchmark_cext_trampoline.py sets it to the scheduling priority the timed child must hold (a u32 priority class on Windows, an i32 nice value on Linux), and configure_cext_benchmark_process in cpython_abi_hooks.rs reads it and panics when it is unset, non-numeric, or the child's actual priority differs. |
| `MOLT_CEXT_BENCH_ITERATIONS` | int | `1000000` | `runtime/molt-runtime/src/cpython_abi_hooks.rs` | tools/benchmark_cext_trampoline.py sets it to the timed call count for each benchmark child, and the cext trampoline benchmark test reads it as a usize; values below 100000 or non-numeric fall back to 1000000, and warmup uses one twentieth of it with a floor of 10000. |
| `MOLT_CEXT_BENCH_ORDER` | enum: `baseline-first`, `candidate-first` | `baseline-first` | `runtime/molt-runtime/src/cpython_abi_hooks.rs` | tools/benchmark_cext_trampoline.py alternates it per sample, and the cext trampoline benchmark test reads it to choose whether the baseline or the candidate call path is timed first; default baseline-first, any other spelling panics. |
| `MOLT_CEXT_BENCH_TARGET_CPU` | int | unset | `runtime/molt-runtime/src/cpython_abi_hooks.rs` | tools/benchmark_cext_trampoline.py sets it to the logical CPU index reserved for the timed child, and configure_cext_benchmark_process in cpython_abi_hooks.rs pins the child to that CPU (affinity mask on Windows, sched_setaffinity on Linux) and panics when it is unset, non-numeric, or the pin fails. |
| `MOLT_CEXT_BENCH_TARGET_MASK` | int | unset | `runtime/molt-runtime/src/cpython_abi_hooks.rs` | tools/benchmark_cext_trampoline.py sets it on Windows to the single-bit process affinity mask for the timed child, and configure_cext_benchmark_process in cpython_abi_hooks.rs applies that mask as a usize and panics when it is unset, non-numeric, holds more than one bit, or disagrees with MOLT_CEXT_BENCH_TARGET_CPU. |
| `MOLT_DEBUG_EVAL_CANDIDATE_JSON` | string | unset | `src/molt/cli/debug_helpers.py` | Set by molt debug bisect in config mode for each --eval-command child to the candidate config as sorted JSON; the evaluator script reads it and nothing in Molt does. |
| `MOLT_DEBUG_EVAL_INPUT` | path | unset | `src/molt/cli/debug_helpers.py` | Set by molt debug reduce and bisect for each --eval-command child to the path of the candidate source file to evaluate (the scratch reduction copy, or the original source); the evaluator script reads it and nothing in Molt does. |
| `MOLT_DEBUG_EVAL_MODE` | enum: `reduce`, `bisect-pass`, `bisect-config` | unset | `src/molt/cli/debug_helpers.py` | Set by molt debug reduce and bisect for each --eval-command child to the evaluation mode, one of reduce, bisect-pass, or bisect-config; the evaluator script reads it and nothing in Molt does. |
| `MOLT_DEBUG_EVAL_ORACLE_JSON` | string | unset | `src/molt/cli/debug_helpers.py` | Set by molt debug reduce and bisect for each --eval-command child to the failure oracle as sorted JSON; the evaluator script reads it and nothing in Molt does. |
| `MOLT_DEBUG_EVAL_PASSES_CSV` | list | unset | `src/molt/cli/debug_helpers.py` | Set by molt debug bisect in pass mode for each --eval-command child to the comma-separated prefix of pass names to run; the evaluator script reads it and nothing in Molt does. |
| `MOLT_DEBUG_EVAL_PASSES_JSON` | string | unset | `src/molt/cli/debug_helpers.py` | Set by molt debug bisect in pass mode for each --eval-command child to the same pass-name prefix as a JSON list; the evaluator script reads it and nothing in Molt does. |
| `MOLT_DEBUG_EVAL_SOURCE_PATH` | path | unset | `src/molt/cli/debug_helpers.py` | Set by molt debug reduce and bisect for each --eval-command child to the path of the original failing source file; the evaluator script reads it and nothing in Molt does. |
| `MOLT_DEMO_SERVER_PID` | int | unset | `bench/scripts/run_demo_bench.py` | Set by run_stack.sh to the demo HTTP server's PID and read by run_demo_bench.py as the root of the server process tree for CPU and RSS sampling; unset or non-numeric falls back to listen PIDs on MOLT_SERVER_PORT and command-name matching. |
| `MOLT_DEMO_WORKER_BIN` | path | unset | `bench/scripts/run_demo_bench.py` | Set by run_stack.sh to the molt-worker binary it built or found and read by run_demo_bench.py to record that binary's path, size, and SHA-256 in the run's composite artifact; unset records no worker identity. |
| `MOLT_DEMO_WORKER_PID` | int | unset | `bench/scripts/run_demo_bench.py` | Set by run_stack.sh to the molt-worker PID and read by run_demo_bench.py as the root of the worker process tree for CPU and RSS sampling; unset or non-numeric falls back to command-name matching. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_GUEST_OUTPUT_IDENTITY` | string | unset | `tools/compat/diff_output_layout.py` | Set by the differential output layout when it admits MOLT_DIFF_GUEST_OUTPUT_ROOT, holding that root's canonical JSON declaration for child processes; re-admission reads it to refuse a changed or malformed selection, and it is an error without the root. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_MEMORY_GUARD_TRIP_FILE` | path | unset | `tools/memory_guard_core/harness_outcomes.py` | Path of the suite memory-guard trip marker; tests/molt_diff.py sets it to MOLT_DIFF_ROOT/memory_guard/tripped.json for the run, and tools/memory_guard_core/harness_outcomes.py reads it to attribute RSS trips to completed commands, treating a malformed file as an infrastructure failure. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_RESULTS_JSONL` | path | unset | `tests/molt_diff.py` | Append-only JSONL sink where tests/molt_diff.py records one line per test with its raw status before the xfail overlay plus the resolved status and per-backend rows; tools/check_suite_honesty.py and tools/verified_subset.py set it for the harness they launch, and unset records nothing. |
| `MOLT_DIFF_TARGET_MODE` | enum: `dyld`, `isolated-retry` | unset | `tools/compat/diff_output_layout.py` | Names the isolation lane that owns a differential Cargo target inside the guest output root; tests/molt_diff.py sets dyld or isolated-retry when it activates a quarantine or an isolated retry, and tools/compat/diff_output_layout.py reads it to admit that target, otherwise only the shared cargo-target directory is allowed. |
| `MOLT_ENTRY_MODULE` | string | `__main__` | `src/molt/cli/config_resolution.py` | Entry module name of the program being compiled; src/molt/cli sets it for the backend process, which defaults to __main__ and uses it to classify user-owned symbols for the shared-stdlib partition, the compiled program's entry stub reads it to detect a multiprocessing spawn child, and multiprocessing sets it to multiprocessing.spawn for the children it launches. |
| `MOLT_EXECUTION_TARGET` | enum: `wasi`, `browser`, `cloudflare`, `native` | `wasi` | `runtime/molt-runtime/src/async_rt/channels/capabilities.rs` | Execution target the wasm32 runtime uses to decide which host operations are supported; the Molt hosts set it (wasm/run_wasm.js wasi, wasm/browser_host.js browser, the Cloudflare worker shim cloudflare, the native main stub native), the runtime lowercases it and assumes wasi when unset, and native builds ignore it. |
| `MOLT_GUARDED_STACK_INNER` | bool | `0` | `bench/scripts/run_stack.sh` | bench/scripts/run_stack.sh sets it to 1 before it re-executes itself under tools/guarded_exec.py; the inner run reads it to skip the demo-run directory binding and the guard wrap, and tools/check_memory_guard_wiring.py requires the token in that script. |
