| `MOLT_HOST_ROOT` | path | unset | `tools/throughput_env.sh` | tools/molt_shell_env.sh exports it from molt_init_shell_context as the repo root in the selected Python's path form (cygpath or wslpath host form when that Python uses Windows paths); tools/throughput_env.sh and tools/witness_cycle.sh read it as their ROOT. |
| `MOLT_JOURNAL_TEST_DIRECTORY` | path | unset | `tools/proof_supervisor/src/lib.rs` | Owned rendezvous directory passed to native supervisor journal-failure test children; read only in the development test binary. |
| `MOLT_JOURNAL_TEST_WORKER` | enum: `0`, `1` | unset | `tools/proof_supervisor/src/lib.rs` | Selects one of the two native supervisor journal-failure test workers; unset selects the test root, and no shipped runtime reads it. |
| `MOLT_L7_AFFINITY_MASK` | string | unset | `runtime/molt-cpython-abi/tests/l7_numeric_perf_attestation.rs` | tools/bench/run_l7_numeric_attestation.py and run_list_delta_attestation.py set it for the release attestation test binaries; the tests read it as a hexadecimal CPU mask (optional 0x prefix) that must select exactly one logical CPU, pin the benchmark thread to it, and panic when it is missing or empty. |
| `MOLT_L7_BUILD_FINGERPRINT` | string | unset | `runtime/molt-cpython-abi/tests/l7_numeric_perf_attestation.rs` | tools/bench/run_l7_numeric_attestation.py and run_list_delta_attestation.py set it to the built test artifact's fingerprint; the release attestation tests copy it into the attestation JSON source block and panic when it is missing or empty. |
| `MOLT_L7_GIT_COMMIT` | string | unset | `runtime/molt-cpython-abi/tests/l7_numeric_perf_attestation.rs` | tools/bench/run_l7_numeric_attestation.py and run_list_delta_attestation.py set it to the source git commit; the release attestation tests copy it into the attestation JSON source block and panic when it is missing or empty. |
| `MOLT_L7_GIT_DIRTY` | bool | unset | `runtime/molt-cpython-abi/tests/l7_numeric_perf_attestation.rs` | tools/bench/run_l7_numeric_attestation.py and run_list_delta_attestation.py set it to true or false from the git worktree state; the release attestation tests record true as a dirty source tree, treat any other value as clean, and panic when it is missing or empty. |
| `MOLT_L7_RUN_NONCE` | string | unset | `runtime/molt-cpython-abi/tests/l7_numeric_perf_attestation.rs` | tools/bench/run_l7_numeric_attestation.py and run_list_delta_attestation.py set it to the run nonce that names the run's capsules; the release attestation tests copy it into the attestation JSON source block and panic when it is missing or empty. |
| `MOLT_L7_RUSTC` | string | unset | `runtime/molt-cpython-abi/tests/l7_numeric_perf_attestation.rs` | tools/bench/run_l7_numeric_attestation.py and run_list_delta_attestation.py set it to the rustc version string of the build; the release attestation tests copy it into the attestation JSON source block and panic when it is missing or empty. |
| `MOLT_MEMORY_GUARD_ACTIVE` | bool | `0` | `src/molt/pytest_memory_guard_bootstrap.py` | tools/memory_guard.py sets it to 1 in every guarded child's environment; the pytest guard bootstrap reads it with MOLT_MEMORY_GUARD_PID to detect an enclosing guard, tools/dx_build_timer.py reads any truthy value for the same purpose, and the proof queue treats it as queue custody. |
| `MOLT_MEMORY_GUARD_COMMAND_JSON` | string | unset | `tools/memory_guard.py` | tools/memory_guard.py sets it to the JSON string list of the guarded command when it launches its hidden worker process; the worker reads it only when MOLT_MEMORY_GUARD_INTERNAL is 1, fails on a missing, invalid, non-list, or empty payload, and the child environment drops it. |
| `MOLT_MEMORY_GUARD_INTERNAL` | bool | `0` | `tools/memory_guard.py` | tools/memory_guard.py sets it to 1 for the hidden worker process that owns the guarded child; the worker reads it to take the command from MOLT_MEMORY_GUARD_COMMAND_JSON instead of argv, and the child environment drops it. |
| `MOLT_MEMORY_GUARD_LAUNCH_ID` | string | unset | `tools/memory_guard_core/cli_contract.py` | tools/command_execution.py sets it to a 32-character lowercase hex launch id when it starts a memory_guard worker with a startup report; the worker's reporting reads it with MOLT_MEMORY_GUARD_STARTUP_JSON to bind the startup and terminal reports to one launch and rejects a malformed value. |
| `MOLT_MEMORY_GUARD_MARKER` | path | unset | `src/molt/pytest_memory_guard_bootstrap.py` | tools/memory_guard.py sets it to the guard-<pid>-<token>.json marker it writes in the active directory of the memory-guard state root; the pytest bootstrap validates it against that directory, molt.temporary_artifacts matches it against the scratch owner record, and persistent daemons never inherit it. |
| `MOLT_MEMORY_GUARD_PID` | int | unset | `src/molt/pytest_memory_guard_bootstrap.py` | tools/memory_guard.py sets it to its own process id for every guarded child; the pytest guard bootstrap reads it when MOLT_MEMORY_GUARD_ACTIVE is 1 and ignores a non-positive or non-integer value. |
| `MOLT_MEMORY_GUARD_STARTUP_JSON` | path | unset | `tools/memory_guard_core/cli_contract.py` | tools/command_execution.py sets it to the absolute path where the memory_guard worker must write its startup report (launch id, guard pid, command, child process); the worker reads it with MOLT_MEMORY_GUARD_LAUNCH_ID and rejects a relative path. |
| `MOLT_MEMORY_GUARD_TOKEN` | string | unset | `src/molt/pytest_memory_guard_bootstrap.py` | tools/memory_guard.py sets it to a random 32-character hex token for each guarded child; the pytest bootstrap requires at least 16 characters to accept an enclosing guard, molt.temporary_artifacts names the scratch generation with it, and persistent daemons never inherit it. |
| `MOLT_MP_ENTRY` | string | unset | `src/molt/stdlib/multiprocessing/_core.py` | Module name of the parent's entry module; multiprocessing Process.start and the pool worker spawn set it for the child, and the child's _spawn_main imports it to rebuild __main__ (treated as __main__ when unset). |
| `MOLT_MP_MAIN_PATH` | path | unset | `src/molt/stdlib/multiprocessing/_core.py` | Absolute path of the parent's __main__ file; multiprocessing spawn sets it for the child, and the child's _spawn_main derives a fallback module name from it when the entry module is __main__; unset adds no path candidate. |
| `MOLT_MP_SPAWN` | bool | `0` | `src/molt/frontend/lowering/module_lifecycle.py` | Marks a multiprocessing child; the parent sets it to 1 when it spawns a Process or pool worker, the compiled entry module skips its top-level body when it reads the exact value 1, multiprocessing.spawn then runs spawn_main, and the runtime process-io trace reports whether it is present. |
| `MOLT_MP_START_METHOD` | string | unset | `src/molt/stdlib/multiprocessing/_core.py` | Start method name the parent selected (spawn, fork, or forkserver); multiprocessing spawn sets it for the child, and the child's _spawn_main adopts it as its default start method; unset keeps the child's built-in default. |
| `MOLT_PROOF_CHILD_CUSTODY_ENDPOINT` | string | unset | `tools/proof_queue_pkg/python_child_custody.py` | host:port of the proof queue's child custody event server; the guarded proof runner sets it for every Python child, and the child custody bootstrap connects to it to journal executable admissions; a missing or malformed endpoint fails the child. |
| `MOLT_PROOF_CHILD_CUSTODY_JSON` | string | unset | `tools/proof_queue_pkg/python_child_custody.py` | JSON policy (schema molt.proof-child-custody.v1) that names the toolchain closure a proof child may execute; the guarded proof runner sets it, and the Python child custody bootstrap installs its audit hook only when the value is present. |
| `MOLT_PROOF_CHILD_CUSTODY_TOKEN` | string | unset | `tools/proof_queue_pkg/python_child_custody.py` | Secret the proof child presents on the custody channel so the event server can authenticate it; the guarded proof runner sets it together with the endpoint, and the child custody bootstrap reads it. |
| `MOLT_PROOF_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SEC` | float | unset | `src/molt/cargo_execution_policy.py` | Calibrated wall-clock budget in seconds of the owning proof command; tools/proof_plan.py sets it for each command child and rejects plan env overrides, and nested Cargo or execution guards in that child raise their default timeouts to at least this floor; a non-positive or non-finite value is an error. |
| `MOLT_PROOF_QUEUE` | bool | `0` | `src/molt/pytest_memory_guard_bootstrap.py` | Marks a process launched by the proof queue runner, which sets it to 1 beside MOLT_PROOF_QUEUE_DB and MOLT_PROOF_QUEUE_RUN_ID; the pytest guard bootstrap and the final WASM runtime preflight require the exact value 1, dx_build_timer accepts 1, true, yes, or on to reuse the outer memory guard, and the same name is the queue's guard-limit prefix. |
| `MOLT_PROOF_QUEUE_DB` | path | unset | `src/molt/pytest_memory_guard_bootstrap.py` | Path of the proof queue's SQLite database (suffix .sqlite3); the queue runner sets it for each guarded run, and the pytest guard bootstrap and the final WASM runtime preflight read it to verify the run's custody. |
| `MOLT_PROOF_QUEUE_RUN_ID` | string | unset | `src/molt/pytest_memory_guard_bootstrap.py` | Identifier of the current proof queue run (at most 240 characters); the queue runner sets it for each guarded child, and the pytest guard bootstrap, the final WASM runtime preflight, and pact witness acceptance read it to bind evidence to that run. |
| `MOLT_PROOF_SCRATCH_ROOT` | path | unset | `src/molt/dx.py` | Scratch directory a guarded proof run may write its outputs to; the proof queue's guarded execution sets a fresh one per run, and tools that produce artifacts default their output roots to it; when unset tools write under the checkout custody root's tmp directory. |
| `MOLT_PROOF_SOURCE_EXTENSION_LINK_INPUTS` | string | unset | `src/molt/source_extension_link_inputs.py` | JSON record (schema molt.source-extension-link-inputs.v2) of the captured source-extension link inputs for a target triple; the guarded proof runner sets it for typed producer commands, the CLI validates and uses it instead of capturing the inputs itself, and the execution environment refuses user-supplied values. |
| `MOLT_PROOF_SOURCE_ROOT` | path | unset | `tools/proof_queue_pkg/python_custody_bootstrap.py` | Absolute canonical path of the proof queue's validated source snapshot; the guarded proof runner sets it for typed commands, the Python custody bootstrap exposes that checkout's src only to the typed Molt module payload, and user-supplied values are refused. |
| `MOLT_PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST_FILE` | path | unset | `src/molt/pytest_memory_guard_bootstrap.py` | Path of the JSON file that records the currently running pytest test under memory-guard custody; the guard bootstrap sets it for the re-executed pytest child and the proof queue runner sets it for test commands, and the bootstrap canonicalizes it and requires it when it verifies proof queue custody. |
| `MOLT_PYTEST_OUTER_GUARD_REEXEC` | bool | `0` | `src/molt/pytest_memory_guard_bootstrap.py` | The pytest guard bootstrap sets it to 1 when it re-executes pytest under tools/memory_guard.py; the child raises if it sees the flag without a live guard ancestor, and dx treats any non-empty value as a pytest context. |
| `MOLT_PYTHON` | path | unset | `tools/molt_shell_env.sh` | Python interpreter path that tools/molt_shell_env.sh exports from molt_init_shell_context (the checkout's venv python.exe or .venv/bin/python, else python3 on PATH) for the scripts that source it; molt_run_context_env reuses an already exported value. |
| `MOLT_REGRTEST_COVERAGE` | bool | `0` | `tools/molt_regrtest_shim.py` | tools/cpython_regrtest.py sets it to 1 for the regrtest shim child when coverage is enabled; tools/molt_regrtest_shim.py then adds coverage --parallel-mode arguments; any other value disables coverage. |
| `MOLT_REGRTEST_COVERAGE_DIR` | path | unset | `tools/molt_regrtest_shim.py` | Directory whose .coverage data file the regrtest shim writes; tools/cpython_regrtest.py sets it for the shim child, and the shim skips coverage when it is unset. |
| `MOLT_REGRTEST_COVERAGE_SOURCE` | list | unset | `tools/molt_regrtest_shim.py` | Comma-separated source packages the regrtest shim passes as coverage --source; tools/cpython_regrtest.py sets it for the shim child from its coverage_source list. |
| `MOLT_REPO_ROOT` | path | unset | `bench/scripts/run_stack.sh` | Repository root that bench/scripts/run_stack.sh exports for its embedded Python helper; the helper falls back to the script's grandparent directory when it is unset. |
| `MOLT_RUNTIME_CALLABLE_SYMBOLS` | path | unset | `runtime/molt-ir/src/runtime_callable_symbols.rs` | Path of the file listing the linked runtime staticlib's molt_* callable symbols, one per line; the CLI (src/molt/cli/runtime_native_codegen.py) sets it with MOLT_RUNTIME_CALLABLE_SYMBOLS_SHA256 for the backend child, which must receive both or neither and panics on a missing file, digest mismatch, non-UTF-8 content or an empty list; unset lets only standalone codegen probes run. |
| `MOLT_RUNTIME_CALLABLE_SYMBOLS_SHA256` | string | unset | `runtime/molt-ir/src/runtime_callable_symbols.rs` | Lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 digest of the MOLT_RUNTIME_CALLABLE_SYMBOLS file; the CLI (src/molt/cli/runtime_native_codegen.py) sets it for the backend child, which verifies the file bytes against it before admitting any callable symbol and panics on mismatch or when only one of the pair is set. |
| `MOLT_SESSION_ID_GENERATED` | bool | `0` | `src/molt/dx.py` | Marks MOLT_SESSION_ID as generated rather than pinned; src/molt/dx.py sets it to 1 in the environment it builds when it generates the session id, and its readers in dx.py (1, true, yes, or on) then treat the session as unpinned and keep the stable shared Cargo target dir; a person never sets it. |
| `MOLT_SHELL_ROOT` | path | unset | `tools/molt_shell_env.sh` | Repository root that molt_init_shell_context in tools/molt_shell_env.sh records from its argument and exports, then uses to select MOLT_PYTHON and MOLT_HOST_ROOT; no other code reads it and a person never sets it. |
| `MOLT_STDLIB_CACHE_KEY` | string | unset | `runtime/molt-backend/src/backend_process/daemon/cache/job/policy.rs` | Expected cache key of the shared stdlib archive named by MOLT_STDLIB_OBJ; src/molt/cli/backend_compile.py sets it for the backend child, which admits the cached archive only when the sidecar key and MOLT_STDLIB_CACHE_MANIFEST both match; a person never sets it. |
| `MOLT_STDLIB_CACHE_MANIFEST` | string | unset | `runtime/molt-backend/src/backend_process/daemon/cache/job/policy.rs` | Expected manifest text (cache variant, target triple and compiler fingerprint) of the shared stdlib archive; src/molt/cli/backend_compile.py sets it for the backend child beside MOLT_STDLIB_CACHE_KEY, and a mismatch with the archive sidecar is a cache miss; a person never sets it. |
| `MOLT_STDLIB_MODULE_SYMBOLS` | string | unset | `runtime/molt-ir/src/stdlib_module_symbols.rs` | JSON array of unique, non-empty ASCII identifier strings naming the stdlib modules that belong to the shared stdlib partition; src/molt/cli/backend_compile.py sets it for the backend child when the stdlib object split is active, and the backend rejects malformed JSON and empty, duplicate or non-identifier entries; a person never sets it. |
| `MOLT_STDLIB_OBJ` | path | unset | `runtime/molt-backend-native/src/native_backend/simple_backend/module_metadata.rs` | Path of the shared stdlib object or archive for the native stdlib partition; src/molt/cli/backend_compile.py sets it for the backend child, which activates partition externalization only when the file exists and MOLT_ENTRY_MODULE is set, and rejects a non-Unicode path; a person never sets it. |
| `MOLT_TEST_APP_BOOTSTRAP_UNAVAILABLE_CHILD` | bool | unset | `runtime/molt-runtime-core/src/app_bootstrap.rs` | A cargo unit test in app_bootstrap.rs sets it to 1 when it re-executes its own test binary, and the child reads its presence (any value) to run the unavailable-initializer abort path; a person never sets it. |
| `MOLT_TEST_COLD_SCRATCH_ALLOC_CHILD` | bool | unset | `runtime/molt-runtime/src/wasm_abi_exports.rs` | A cargo unit test in wasm_abi_exports.rs sets it to 1 when it re-executes its own test binary, and the child reads its presence (any value) to run the cold resource-denial scratch allocation path; a person never sets it. |
| `MOLT_TEST_PID_FILE` | path | unset | `runtime/molt-runtime/src/async_rt/process.rs` | A cargo unit test in process.rs sets it to a temp path for the sh child it spawns, and the shell command writes its background sleep pid there so the test can check process-group teardown; a person never sets it. |
| `MOLT_TEST_SCRIPT_OUTER_GUARD_REEXEC` | bool | `0` | `src/molt/pytest_memory_guard_bootstrap.py` | src/molt/pytest_memory_guard_bootstrap.py sets it to 1 in the environment of a repo test module or script it re-executes under tools/memory_guard.py, and the re-executed child reads it (any non-empty value) to raise when no live ancestor guard can be verified; a person never sets it. |
| `MOLT_TEST_SOURCE_IDENTITY_JSON` | string | unset | `runtime/test_support/captured_runtime_children.rs` | JSON object describing the admitted Cargo truth source identity; tools/cargo_test_binary_runner.py sets it for the cargo test binary child, and runtime/test_support/captured_runtime_children.rs reads it into the source_identity field of each MOLT_RUNTIME_DESCENDANT_RECEIPT record, panicking on invalid JSON; unset records null; a person never sets it. |
| `MOLT_TYPE_GATE` | bool | `0` | `runtime/molt-runtime/src/object/ops_sys.rs` | molt build --type-gate sets it to 1 in the backend environment; the runtime's exported molt_runtime_init_type_gate reads exactly 1 and records a flag that nothing enforces, and no code in the tree calls that initializer. |
| `MOLT_VSDEVCMD_CALL` | string | unset | `src/molt/platform_toolchain.py` | src/molt/platform_toolchain.py sets it to the quoted VsDevCmd.bat path in the environment of the cmd.exe child it runs to capture the MSVC build environment; the child command expands it as %MOLT_VSDEVCMD_CALL%, and the captured environment drops it afterwards. |
| `MOLT_WASI_C_ABI_PLAN` | string | unset | `src/molt/wasi_sdk_identity.py` | Bounded versioned projection of the manifest-selected WASI SDK C runtime, shared by Python consumers and Rust build scripts. Contains the exact single-thread wasip1 target, SDK roots and libc/long-double/compiler-rt/CRT content identities. Missing, malformed or conflicting projections refuse C-runtime builds; environment text is not native content-use attestation. |
| `MOLT_WASM_CPYTHON_ABI_DATA_EXPORTS` | list | unset | `runtime/molt-runtime/build.rs` | src/molt/cli/runtime_wasm_build_spec.py sets it to the newline-separated CPython ABI data symbols the wasm32 runtime must export; runtime/molt-runtime/build.rs reads it and panics when a symbol is not also in MOLT_WASM_CPYTHON_ABI_EXPORTS, and the runtime build identity records the sorted symbol set; unset means no data exports. |
| `MOLT_WASM_CPYTHON_ABI_EXPORTS` | list | unset | `runtime/molt-runtime/build.rs` | src/molt/cli/runtime_wasm_build_spec.py sets it to the newline-separated CPython ABI function symbols the wasm32 runtime must export; runtime/molt-runtime/build.rs reads it to emit export anchors (ignored for non-wasm32 targets), and the runtime build identity records the sorted symbol set; unset means no requested exports. |
| `MOLT_WASM_DATA_BASE` | int | `1048576` | `runtime/molt-backend-wasm/src/wasm_options.rs` | src/molt/cli/wasm_codegen_layout.py sets it in the WASM backend environment to the data segment base address in bytes after backend_compile.py drops any inherited value; the backend rounds it up to 8 bytes and clamps it to u32; non-numeric or unset means 1048576 (1 MiB). |
| `MOLT_WASM_EXPORT_CALLS_JSON` | path | unset | `wasm/run_wasm.js` | tools/bench_wasm.py sets it for its node run_wasm.js child: the path of a JSON file whose calls array names app exports and arguments that the host invokes after main initialization; a file without a calls array is an error and unset means no host export calls. |
| `MOLT_WASM_PROFILE` | enum: `auto`, `full`, `pure` | `auto` | `runtime/molt-backend-wasm/src/wasm_options.rs` | Wasm import-planning profile for the wasm backend: auto, full, or pure (the backend treats any other spelling as auto); molt build sets it from --wasm-profile in the backend process environment, and the frontend takes the same value as a parameter (pure also enables pure-wasm dead-module elimination when tree shaking is on); default auto. |
| `MOLT_WASM_RELOCATABLE` | bool | unset | `runtime/molt-backend-wasm/src/wasm_options.rs` | src/molt/cli/wasm_codegen_layout.py sets it to 1 in the WASM backend environment, after backend_compile.py drops any inherited value, when the build links the module (relocatable codegen with relocation sections for wasm-ld); only the exact value 1 enables it. |
| `MOLT_WASM_SPLIT_RUNTIME_APP_TABLE_BASE` | int | unset | `src/molt/cli/backend_compile.py` | molt build strips any inherited value and sets it for the wasm backend process from the bound runtime layout: the app's function-table base (u32) in a split-runtime build, which the backend ignores when it does not parse; unset means no split-runtime app table base. |
| `MOLT_WITNESS_EXPECTED_GIT_HEAD` | string | unset | `tools/pact_witness_acceptance.py` | tools/proof_queue_pkg/pact.py sets it for the pact witness acceptance child to the expected git HEAD commit; tools/pact_witness_acceptance.py refuses to run when it is unset or when the checkout's HEAD differs. |
| `MOLT_WITNESS_EXPECTED_REPO_ROOT` | path | unset | `tools/pact_witness_acceptance.py` | tools/proof_queue_pkg/pact.py sets it for the pact witness acceptance child to the resolved repository root; tools/pact_witness_acceptance.py refuses to run when it is unset or when the git toplevel or its own root differs from it. |

## Guard scopes and families

Family names are built at run time as `<STEM><SUFFIX>`. The stem is the guard scope a Molt tool runs its subprocesses under; the scope-specific name wins over the root fallback when both are set.

### Families

| Family | Kind | Default | Root fallback | Read by | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `MOLT_<STEM>_CHILD_RLIMIT_GB` | float | unset | `MOLT_CHILD_RLIMIT_GB` | `tools/harness_memory_guard.py` | Guard-scope direct-child RLIMIT_RSS request in GiB; the default follows the live process budget capped by tree/global budgets, and zero disables this optional kernel layer without disabling sampled RSS checks. Separately, the root MOLT_CHILD_RLIMIT_GB is read by Linux runtime child startup: a positive resolved value tightens the budget derived from raw-integer MOLT_RESOURCE_MAX_MEMORY (including headroom), or supplies the budget when absent; zero skips this explicit RLIMIT_DATA installation. Human-readable parent memory values do not enter that numeric derivation. A selected runtime child cap that cannot be installed fails child startup; inherited OS limits remain separate. |
| `MOLT_<STEM>_KEEPALIVE_SEC` | float | `20` | `MOLT_SUBPROCESS_KEEPALIVE_SEC` | `tools/harness_memory_guard.py` | Seconds between keepalive progress lines for streamed guarded commands in the scope; 0 or a negative value disables them. |
| `MOLT_<STEM>_MAX_GLOBAL_RSS_GB` | float | unset | `MOLT_MAX_GLOBAL_RSS_GB` | `tools/harness_memory_guard.py` | Global RSS budget in GB across all Molt process groups for the scope; default is the adaptive live-memory budget, clamped below the hard cap. |
| `MOLT_<STEM>_MAX_PROCESS_RSS_GB` | float | unset | `MOLT_MAX_PROCESS_RSS_GB` | `tools/harness_memory_guard.py` | Per-process RSS budget in GB for the scope; default is the adaptive live-memory budget, clamped below the tree budget. |
| `MOLT_<STEM>_MAX_TOTAL_RSS_GB` | float | unset | `MOLT_MAX_TOTAL_RSS_GB` | `tools/harness_memory_guard.py` | Process-tree RSS budget in GB for the scope; default is the adaptive live-memory budget, clamped below the global budget. |
| `MOLT_<STEM>_MEMORY_AVAILABLE_GB` | float | unset | `MOLT_MEMORY_AVAILABLE_GB` | `tools/memory_guard_core/memory_limits.py` | Overrides the measured available memory in GB that the adaptive budget starts from; default is read from the OS. |
| `MOLT_<STEM>_MEMORY_GUARD_POLL_SEC` | float | `0.1` | `MOLT_MEMORY_GUARD_POLL_SEC` | `tools/harness_memory_guard.py` | Steady-state RSS polling interval in seconds for the scope; non-positive values fall back to 0.1. |
| `MOLT_<STEM>_MEMORY_RESERVE_GB` | float | unset | `MOLT_MEMORY_RESERVE_GB` | `tools/memory_guard_core/memory_limits.py` | Memory in GB the adaptive budget keeps free for the OS and other work; default is 6% of physical memory clamped to 1-12 GB. |
| `MOLT_<STEM>_MEMORY_TOTAL_GB` | float | unset | `MOLT_MEMORY_TOTAL_GB` | `tools/memory_guard_core/memory_limits.py` | Overrides the measured physical memory in GB that the adaptive budget starts from; default is read from the OS. |
| `MOLT_<STEM>_REPO_SENTINEL_ACTIVE` | bool | `0` | `MOLT_REPO_SENTINEL_ACTIVE` | `tools/harness_memory_guard.py` | Set by a suite-level repo sentinel for the commands it covers, so per-command orphan cleanup defers to that sentinel. |
| `MOLT_<STEM>_TIMEOUT_SEC` | float | unset | `MOLT_TEST_PROCESS_TIMEOUT_SEC` | `tools/harness_memory_guard.py` | Wall-clock limit in seconds for guarded commands in the scope; each adapter has its own bounded default, and 0 means unbounded for a deliberate local investigation. |

| `MOLT_WITNESS_ITER` | `tools/witness_iter.py` | Guard scope for witness iteration runs. |

## Prefix families

Names built from a fixed prefix and an open member set.

| Family | Kind | Audience | Read by | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `MOLT_CARGO_INPUT_<MEMBER>` | string | internal | `tools/proof_queue_pkg/supervisor_generation.py` | One per proof-supervisor workspace crate (upper-cased name): the SHA-256 fingerprint of that crate's sources, passed to the supervisor build. |
